course_name: 數位匯流與智財法律專題(二)
outline: The aim of this course is designed to help students of diversified background to have a comprehensive understanding of the impact of digital technology towards IP laws. The topics of this course focus on  IP protection of online content and intangible data ownership and usage. Students will establish the legal analysis skills in cases and develop research interests in IP legal development  in the rapidly changing cyberspace.
schedule: The schedule will be released to the students at the first class and possible amendments might be made in order to accommodate students' backgrounds.
assessment: course participation :30% , course assignments: 30%, final course report :40%.
materials:
